verdict.rationale: Convertio documents an API with personal API keys, its own command-line interface, and official wrappers such as PHP. Together these let conversions run without the browser UI, so scripted or CI pipelines are possible, and conversion runs in the cloud. The evidence is only brief claimed-docs mentions, though. missing for 10: CLI usage and installation details, any CI integration examples or guidance, a published machine-readable API spec (the OpenAPI probe returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
